variants.headline: Love them longer with vet-formulated joint support
variants.body: Your senior dog is family. Help them stay active with our premium, grain-free recipe. Vet-formulated with transparent, high-quality ingredients to support joint health and longevity, delivered monthly by subscription. Because they deserve the absolute best in their golden years.
variants.rationale: This copy combines an emotional, family-focused connection with the transparent, vet-formulated credentials that pet parents trust.

variants.headline: Scientifically optimized joint nutrition for your senior dog
variants.body: Extend your dog's active years with our vet-formulated, grain-free senior recipe. Specifically engineered for joint longevity and mobility, our premium subscription delivers precise, clean nutrition to optimize your dog's physical health and support structural recovery.
variants.rationale: It utilizes outcome-focused, scientific terminology like 'engineered' and 'structural recovery' to appeal to the wellness optimizer's systematic approach to health.

variants.headline: Uncompromising joint nutrition for your loyal companion
variants.body: Honor your dog's lifetime of loyalty with our premium, vet-formulated senior recipe. Crafted for joint health and longevity, this grain-free, subscription-based nutrition provides the reliable, high-quality support your companion deserves in their golden years.
variants.rationale: The copy adopts an understated, respectful tone focusing on 'loyalty' and 'craftsmanship' to align with the affluent buyer's appreciation for classic quality.

bidStrategy.rationale: Mid-AOV product: pay per click at 1-2% of order value, a sustainable CPC if roughly 1 in 30 clicks converts

budget.rationale: $1500/publisher/month floor for statistically useful volume × 4 publishers × 1.25 premium-tier multiplier

assumptions: Assumed an average order value of $75 USD based on typical premium pet food subscription market rates.
CPMs are heuristic estimates by audience income tier, not quoted rates
Estimated AOV of $75 inferred from the advertiser's description
